about: Craft checklist, department cinematography (P3b, docs/CRAFT_CURRICULUM.md). Same shape as training/video_criteria.json, plus artefact (the field the check reads), source (docs/research/CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10.md section and verdict, the repository rule, or 'Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified)') and enforced_by (an existing path, a planned validator with its phase in planned, or manual). check = code (a validator measures it), critic (the script-critic or editorial review ticks it), eye (the creator's or Claude's look at the frames), manual (a person does it). Every number is a BP id in sourced_rules.json; nothing here is binding: no row has two verified source types yet. Skill: .claude/skills/shot-visuals/SKILL.md.

criteria.name: every shot card names a lens tier motivated by the beat (long = compression, wide = space)
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §8 (PARTIAL): Wikipedia 'Telephoto lens': 85 mm portrait class only

criteria.name: camera height low / eye / high motivated (low reads strong)
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §8 (PARTIAL): Wikipedia 'Low-angle shot': low = strong and powerful

criteria.name: two shots of one subject in a row change angle by 30 degrees or the lens by 20 mm
screen sides and the axis hold inside a scene
headroom and nose room: a facing figure has lead room toward its gaze
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): Mascelli, Block, Katz not re-opened (CRAFT_SOURCES §8)

criteria.name: depth staging: foreground, midground and background named on the card
the focal point stays within BP-30's shift across a hard cut
criteria.source: repo: BP-30 (binding; the Blueprint's 0.18 is conflict 11)

criteria.name: a per-segment visual intensity rises toward the climax and drops at the resolution, with contrast between neighbours
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): Block, The Visual Story, not re-opened; NOT FOUND (CRAFT_SOURCES §9)

criteria.name: lane shares follow each beat's dramatisability score inside the run caps
criteria.artefact: beat dramatisability score + lane per shot
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §7 (SUPPORTED): YouTube Help 9314415 as the measurement tool; the 60/90 s caps are house numbers

criteria.name: stakes and named heroes in every frame
